explanation: Correct. For r > 1 the only critical value of z^n - r^n is -r^n, of modulus > 1. The closed disc {|w - r^n| ≤ 1} is simply connected and misses 0, so its preimage under z ↦ z^n splits into exactly n components, matching the page's claim about {|f| ≤ 1}. The case n = 1 (one disc) is also consistent.
